profile.title: Mechanical Engineer
profile.bio: I'm a passionate mechanical engineering student with a drive for innovation. I specialize in CAD design, rapid prototyping, and structural analysis. I love turning complex problems into elegant, functional designs.

projects.title: 6-Axis Robotic Arm
projects.description: Designed and prototyped a 6-axis industrial robotic arm. Utilized carbon fiber and brushed aluminum for structural integrity while maintaining a lightweight profile. Programmed the inverse kinematics engine in Python.

projects.title: FSAE Racecar Chassis
projects.description: Led the design and manufacturing of a tubular spaceframe chassis for a Formula SAE race car. Performed rigorous FEA to ensure driver safety and optimize torsional rigidity, resulting in a 15% weight reduction from the previous year.

projects.title: Wind Turbine Blade Analysis
projects.description: Conducted a comprehensive finite element analysis on modern wind turbine blades under extreme aerodynamic stress. The results contributed to a more resilient blade design, improving energy efficiency by 5%.
